metadata.question: Was there an algae bloom visible off the coast of Santa Monica on October 10,  2015?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Santa Monica coast (approximately 34.0195°N, -118.4912°W) - Date: October 10, 2015 - Collection: Landsat 8 (good temporal resolution, bands for water analysis) - Fallback: Sentinel-2 if Landsat 8 has no data 2. Masking strategy: - Cloud mask using QA_PIXEL band (Landsat 8) - Look for high chlorophyll-a signature using normalized chlorophyll index or false-color visualization - FCI (Floating Chlorophyll Index) = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red) for algae detection 3. Logic to distinguish: - C1: No images on Oct 10, 2015 within date window - C2: Images exist but clouds cover the coastal area completely - C3: Invalid FCI values (NaN, out of range) - A: FCI > threshold (algae bloom detected) - B: FCI <= threshold (no bloom detected) - Threshold for algae: FCI > 0.15 or NDVI anomaly visible ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Santa Monica coast geometry const santaMonica = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.4912, 34.0195]); const bufferGeom = santaMonica.buffer(10000); // 10km buffer for coastal area // Date range around October 10, 2015 const startDate = '2015-10-05'; const endDate = '2015-10-15'; // Load Landsat 8 data let col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(bufferGeom) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); let size = col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 8 images found (Oct 5-15, 2015): ${size}`); // If no Landsat, try Sentinel-2 if (size === 0) { col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(bufferGeom) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); size = col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 images found (Oct 5-15, 2015): ${size}`); if (size === 0) { console.log('No data available for October 10, 2015 near Santa Monica.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // Use first available image const img = col.first(); // Calculate Floating Chlorophyll Index (FCI) for algae detection // FCI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red) const fci = img.normalizedDifference(['B5', 'B4']).rename('FCI'); // Count valid pixels const count = fci.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: bufferGeom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const validPixels = count.FCI || 0; console.log(`Valid FCI pixels after masking: ${validPixels}`); if (validPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Calculate mean FCI value const stats = fci.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: bufferGeom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const meanFCI = stats.FCI; console.log(`Mean FCI value: ${meanFCI !== null ? meanFCI.toFixed(4) : 'null'}`); if (meanFCI === null || isNaN(meanFCI)) { console.log('FCI calculation resulted in invalid value.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Algae bloom threshold: FCI > 0.15 indicates potential bloom const bloomThreshold = 0.15; const percentileHigh = fci.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.percentile([75]), geometry: bufferGeom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const p75 = percentileHigh.FCI || 0; console.log(`75th percentile FCI: ${p75.toFixed(4)}`); console.log(`Bloom threshold: ${bloomThreshold}`); const bloomDetected = meanFCI > bloomThreshold || p75 > bloomThreshold; if (bloomDetected) { console.log('Algae bloom signature detected off Santa Monica coast.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('No significant algae bloom detected.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
